memoryInvocation.blockedSemantics: Target emits BLOCKED marker and exits2 after owned guards drop. Cargo may wrap child2 as101; coordinator must map marker to2. No ignored/skip case.

optionalCoordinatedTeamGate.timing: After enabled-cache idle/8-writer measurements, before stopping its actual listener. Real team activity is excluded from benchmark attribution.
optionalCoordinatedTeamGate.preservation: Copy explicit scratch evidence tree durably to LDD_EVIDENCE_DIR/team/RUN_ID; process stdout/stderr remain in outer evidence. Do not copy identity keys/request bodies/model configuration.
optionalCoordinatedTeamGate.blocked: Partial inputs or missing concrete assets emit BLOCKED; child exit2 propagates BLOCKED after owned process cleanup and evidence preservation. No inputs records not-requested/acceptance:false, not overall team completion.
optionalCoordinatedTeamGate.limit: Scratch parent must permit <101-byte control.sock pathname. Scenario has a 20-minute owned process budget.

productionCorrection.trigger: Run actual doctor --fix copy-skills twice in a clean mini-only home; the first run creates its own shared kbd-process-orchestrator directory.
productionCorrection.before: Every directory with that shared name was classified as full ownership, so the second copy refused before preserving managed/unrelated files.
productionCorrection.after: A plain mini directory with a plain bounded owner=prometheus-mini receipt and matching SKILL.md SHA-256 is mini-owned. Missing, malformed, mismatching, linked or generic application receipts remain conflicts; independent CLI/setup/service markers remain conflicts.
productionCorrection.integrationAssertions: First install and rerun preserving operator edits/unrelated source; malformed/mismatch/missing KBD receipts refuse with no home mutation; independent full setup state refuses with no home mutation. Protected assertions untouched.
productionCorrection.limitation: An operator-edited shared KBD SKILL.md no longer matches its receipt and remains ambiguous/refused; there is no automatic ownership adoption or full marker exemption.
